title: Vaishnavism Saints Shankardeva
definition: Srimanta Shankardeva (1449–1568) was a polymath, saint-scholar, and social reformer who pioneered the Ekasarana Dharma (Neo-Vaishnavite movement) in Assam, emphasizing monotheistic devotion to Lord Krishna.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Art & Culture (Bhakti movement) and Medieval History; questions focus on his literary contributions, institutional innovations (Sattras), and socio-cultural impact on Assamese identity.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Shankardeva.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of Bhakti Movement
